items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: T-Bone Walker came out with this conch and he'd point it towards

ctx.x: You know what's funny? Every time I see Clark Terry, you know, we see each other, we always say, "Woman, you must be crazy?" And, now, you know what the significance of that is? We were doing the jazz at the philharmonic's [indiscernible] Hall in London and all the British people are sitting there, you know, like, you know how they would sit, you know, with their, you know, upper class look. We'd play and they'd [clapping softly]. You know? T-Bone Walker came out with this conch and he'd point it towards…
